epilogues.destroy: The seal cracks in Cinderhold's forge fire. No one will command the bound again: not the party, not a warlord, not the Dark Lord himself if he returns. The bound go on keeping orders twenty years old.
epilogues.give: Elder Gorvash takes the seal and swears it will never give an order. The council locks it away, and every warlord in the Dark Lands now knows where it is.
epilogues.keep: The party keeps the seal. Every bound orc and goblin it meets stands aside at a word, and every faction in the Dark Lands starts to wonder what the party will do with them.

notesEpilogue.none: No crafter's notes survive in safe hands.
notesEpilogue.some: In Cinderhold's strongroom lie {n} sets of crafter's notes, and with them the only future the free beastmen have.
